tasks.title: Implement validated interaction and ownership scoped summary state
tasks.description: REQ-014, REQ-001, REQ-002, REQ-006, REQ-008, REQ-010, AC-02, AC-06, AC-07, AC-08, AC-10, AC-13, and AC-14 / Component: Interaction Summary Store and SDK Adapter - add pure ai-summary.ts validators, getCanonicalAISummaryInteractionId reusing findMediaResourceId(task, 'mainCall'), discriminated valid/invalid capability normalization that retains only a recognizable interactionId for fail-closed clearing, payload normalization, timestamp ordering, owner-key guards, response composers, and sanitized error mapping; add stateful StoreWrapper.getOrCreateAISummaryOwnerKey plus pending-request sequence bookkeeping in storeEventsWrapper.ts; add AISummaryOwnerKey, AISummaryOwnerState, AISummaryViewModel including requestPending, AISummarySectionKey, AISummaryDisplaySectionKey, AISummaryEditableField, AISummaryCounters, AISummaryFeedback, PostCallDraftCapture, AISummaryStatusTransition, agentWrappedUpObserved, currentAISummaryOwnerByInteraction, nextAISummaryOwnershipGeneration, and store action signatures to store.types.ts. Normalize admitted post-call resolution as the read-only Outcome display row only when typed sections exist, keep it out of editable/response keys, and retain the exact string bytes for display/copy. Add handleAISummaryFeatureEnablement and pair its exact callback in setupIncomingTaskHandler.addEventListeners/removeEventListeners; store exact task-bound receiving/wrapped-up callbacks so registerTaskEventListeners rebinds safely and handleTaskRemove/cleanUpStore detach exact functions; leave the existing TASK_PARTICIPANT_JOINED, TASK_CONFERENCE_STARTED, TASK_PARTICIPANT_LEFT, and TASK_CONFERENCE_ENDED handlers unchanged and prove they neither fan out an SDK request nor cancel pending summary work; replace only the direct wrapped-up refresh listener with a wrapper that transitions summary state before preserving refreshTaskList. Extend Store and setCurrentTask to make @webex/cc-store the sole caller/listener for the four Task methods and summary events, compute the canonical main-interaction/agent key without using interaction.owner as receiving-agent identity, require the existing registered session plus non-empty authenticated agentId for authorization, preserve same-agent generation across consult-to-transfer and conference content replacement, advance it after terminal clear or agent change, enforce voice/capability/authorization gates, retain accepted same-agent content/counters while a conference-participant preparation request is pending or fails, accept per-agent conference replacements only from the initiating Promise or D0-declared receiving content event, capture post-call draft bytes before wrap-up without freezing lifecycle, freeze/send them once after success even if visibility changes, retain a monotonic content-free status transition through keyed-content cleanup, retain and clear summary memory at required boundaries, order AgentWrappedUp against an in-flight frozen response, ignore stale-owner results while allowing every same-owner response to compete by SDK timestamp, and reject all automatic retry/cancellation/persistence/logging. Modify existing store tests/mocks and module spec and add ai-summary.ts tests for canonical identity, owner-generation triggers, prior-agent non-projection, resolution display/response separation, conference replacement retention, no conference-event request fan-out, leave-without-cancel, event routing, listener rebind/removal, concurrency, feedback, counters, exact freeze, status deduplication, event-before-rejection callback visibility, and zero unhandled rejections. D0/D1 provide the only accepted contracts and deterministic raw inputs required before reducer/event work.
